description: You are a curriculum coordinator at Riverdale Elementary School preparing a Mathematics Curriculum Audit Report for the district school board. GCompris educational software is open on the screen. Your task is to: (1) Navigate to the Mathematics (Numbers) section of GCompris and systematically explore ALL THREE sub-categories within it — Numeration, Arithmetic, and Measures — cataloging every activity visible in each sub-category. (2) Open and interact with at least two math activities (one from the Numeration tab and one from the Arithmetic tab) to understand their pedagogical intent. (3) Write a formal Mathematics Curriculum Audit Report to the file ~/Desktop/math_curriculum_audit.txt. The report must include clearly labeled sections for each sub-category (Numeration, Arithmetic, Measures) with a list of activity names visible in each section and a brief educational objective for each activity. Your district superintendent will review this report to determine if GCompris meets state curriculum standards. Login: ga / password123
